profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer
profile.summary: Specialties: Tools Programming | Software Testing/QA | DevOps.  Experience in: Full Stack | Ecommerce | Data | Backend | Mobile iOS Software Engineering.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Terraform · GitHub · AWS CloudFormation · Makefile · Go (Programming Language) · AWS Identity and Access Management (AWS IAM) · Docker

positions.title: DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
Created the monitoring pipeline. Wrote ​ansible​ tasks to deploy c​ollectd​ to workstations. Monitor machine metrics and send to ​Google Stackdriver​. Packaged the collectd installation into an RPM. Created dynamic graphs in Grafana by ingesting metrics from Stackdriver and utilizing ​Grafana​ variable interpolation.

Setup centralized logging. Utilizes ​fluentd​ to tail logs and send to Google Stackdriver. Wrote a task in ansible to automate deployment to workstations. Tested deployment using ​Vagrant​ and Virtualbox.

Supported ​gitlab​ integration on GCP. Includes updating gitlab, deploying gitlab-runners, and making changes to image caching mechanism. Utilized ​terraform,​ ​kubernetes​, helm, packer, and ​docker​.

positions.title: DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and upgraded the iOS pipeline. Created the pipeline using Fastlane and Jenkins 2.0. Wrote Fastlane configurations and Jenkinsfiles for testing, building and deployment.  Generated templates so each team could build a new app with ready to use tools.

Developed CI for the Fastlane and Jenkins infrastructure. Ensured Fastfiles and Jenkinsfiles were built and tested before deployment to end users. Includes reporting and notifications of build status.

Wrote tools to automate creation and maintenance of Jenkins infrastructure.  Maintained servers, nodes, users and permissions by writing Ansible YAML playbooks and Groovy scripts.

positions.title: Mobile Software Engineer
positions.description:
Wrote and maintained the fastfile for iOS builds and deployment.  Integrated the fastfile and wrote custom fastlane actions to automate the test, build, deploy and release process.
 
Maintained the build machine, build scripts and CI process for the Mobile team.  Troubleshoot build, deploy, test issues.  Added email and Slack integrations for increased communication. Maintained app, cocoapod and software versioning and helped write release notes.
 
Wrote an IPA Testflight uploader for Xamarin C# app.
 
Technical manager for the QA developers.  Held code reviews, organized playtests, read and approved all Pull/Merge Requests, helped troubleshoot issues and integrated changes into the CI pipeline. Managed javascript Instruments:Automation testing, Swift UI testing and helped with selenium and appium tests.
 
Maintained the Rakefile for building, running tests and uploading APK’s for Android app.
 
Wrote a plist to html/pdf conversion tool to increase accessibility of iOS Instruments:Automation UI test results. Wrote an XSL template to convert XML to html by applying appropriate html tags on plist attributes.
 
Designed and set layout and constraints for screens according to UX design specs.
 
Applied custom animation to keyboard in chat app.  Keyboard animates differently based on activity of the inputView, chat tableView, and input alertView’s.  Utilized frames, bounds and offsets to set the proper keyboard and tableView movements and locations.
 
Wrote and designed the pinned posts feature.  These post types are “pinned” to the top of the feed and have a different design treatment applied to them, made visible by conditional constraints.
 
Added the Sqor app to the global sharesheet. Allow posts to be shared from apps such as Twitter and Facebook, into the Sqor app compose post view.
 
Installed and integrated pods including: Realm, Twitter, Facebook, AWS, Google Analytics, New Relic, Applause.
 
Familiar with snapkit and RxSwift.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Wrote the entity system to create, read, update and delete entities. Made two flask REST API’s that maintained a C#, DynamoDB, and postgres backend.  Wrote and designed the backend to transition from one system to another while maintaining parity.
 
Wrote the backend for a charity ecommerce platform. Utilized braintree, flask and javascript to build out a website that handled credit card donations to various charity organizations. Maintained authentication, validation, security and payment processing between customers and merchants.

positions.title: Data Software Engineer
positions.description:
Wrote a data collection tool utilizing Amazon’s Mechanical Turk.  Constructed thousands of HIT assignments to determine athlete social media data. Retrieve dataset and populate database with most popular answers.
 
Helped create the athlete “Sqor” program which collected daily, weekly, and monthly engagement details on athletes and consolidated that data into a single “Sqor” number. Collected data from internal and external sources, such as facebook, twitter, instagram, wikipedia, and google. “Sqor” was deduced by specific weighted attributes and the percentile that the user fell into.
 
Designed a pitch website to show partners our top athlete engagement and content.  
 
Designed an internal webpage to display user and company statistics. Determine athlete pay and cost-benefit based on their engagement tier.  Collates engagement attributes and posts.
 
Wrote tools to store data that we had retrieval limitations on.

positions.title: DevOps Software Engineer
positions.description:
Wrote chef cookbooks, integrated them into AWS Opsworks and deployed them to EC2 instances. Designed recipes to be inherited by other cookbooks.
 
Managed deploys and wrote tools to automate the deploy process. Utilized EC2, S3, ELB and VPC.  
 
Wrote continuous integration pipeline using boto, nose, pylint, coverage, virtualenv, pip and wget.  Added integrations between github, Jenkins, AWS, JIRA and Slack.
 
Wrote python packages to reduce code reuse. Includes CSV file handling, email, and the internal REST API.
 
Wrote various load and performance tests using the pingdom API, funkload, locust, and custom scripts.
 
Onboarded new hires and set up their machines for gmail, github, JIRA, Slack and AWS use.

positions.title: DevOps Software Engineer
positions.description:
Maintained and wrote chef recipes utilizing Berkshelf, vagrant and Rackspace servers.
 
Wrote a logging pipeline utilizing logstash. Used chef recipes involving logstash, Kibana, Redis and nginx to write and read logs to a centralized log server.
 
Wrote a flask server status monitor to notify when a server is up, sluggish or down.  Used internally on displays in office.
 
Published chef recipes for rabbitMQ data pipeline.  Set up queue and nodes to process jobs.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented a git development workflow.  Provides an easier collaborative development environment utilizing git branching, merging and remotes.

Introduced and managed the Jenkins build system.  Maintained build scripts to generate test, lint (code quality) and coverage reports when code is submitted.  

Advocate for software testing and test driven development.  Encouraged people to write white box and black box tests.

Led and participated in team code reviews.  Gave constructive code feedback according to PEP 8 code standards.

Wrote a tool to populate a 3D scene within an animation software package given a text data file.  Filters the data into an intermediate lightweight file format, then converts the data into commands for populating scene geometry, animation and attributes.  

Wrote a tool to convert 3D shot data between proprietary Lucasfilm animation software packages.  Stores data in memory and converts the data to be ingested by the receiving software package.  Handles asset geometry, asset management, animation and versioning.  

Worked on a team to write an asset pose management system. Designed the database schema and utilized poise python bindings to write an API.  Managed data creation, storage, access and output format.

positions.title: Technical Director
positions.description:
Wrote an API in python for the Scratch dailies pipeline.  An abstract layer of modules and classes correspond to objects and stages of the dailies pipeline.  Among these objects include dailies takes, input XML files, configuration files, and log files.  

Wrote the conversion pipeline  for head camera data files (HMCs).  C executable converts HMCs to JPGs.  Executable generates a time code burnin on JPGs.  Python wrapper converts JPGs to MOV using NUKE.  Suite includes data validation, farm job submission functionality and data organization and storage.
	
Wrote the dailies review pipeline system.  Dailies XML files corresponding to user input image sequences are generated and prioritized in a queue.  A daemon on each Scratch dailies playback machine communicates with the queue and copies image sequences onto the playback machine.  Priorities are set using a PyQT GUI that visually represents the queue.  Involves network programming and file locks.

positions.title: Associate Technical Director
positions.description:
Wrote a render farm management system.  The farm job submission tool accepts an input job description, then distributes the workload amongst render machines.  A worker daemon runs on each machine and accepts a job to execute.  Involves network and threaded programming.
	
Wrote a render farm prioritization tool in PyQT.  Allows production management to set farm job priorities.  Retrieves stats for related jobs.  Submitted farm jobs are stored in a MySQL database.

Wrote a media statistics and load progress tool for the Scratch dailies playback machines.  Determines takes loaded onto the machine.  Displays the copy progress of each file sequence.

Wrote a media management tool for the Scratch dailies playback machines.  Determines the age of takes loaded onto the machine and removes old takes to optimize the amount of free disk space.

Maintained the dailies submission system.  Users submit image sequences which are converted to an MOV using rvio, then stored in the Shotgun database.

Wrote a render farm API  in python. Designed as an abstract layer above specific render farm software APIs.
 
Wrote a suite of render farm management tools whose functions include submitting jobs, parsing logs, recording stats, logging into machines, managing processes, retrying jobs, and managing the farm server.

Troubleshot reported software bugs.  Based on user input pertaining to a bug, recreate the problem, then locate and fix the bug.

Trained new render wranglers and ATDs.  Taught software, the pipeline, and the development process.

positions.title: Student Intern
positions.description: Wrote code to determine the average coordinates for each point of 3D mesh scans.  Used a 3D scanner to scan and align objects.  The meshes were landmarked to determine the virtual coordinates and correspondence of each point for each mesh.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Wrote a timecard system that organized and displayed hours worked by employees.  Tool is web based and written in PHP.  Data is stored in a database.

Wrote an automated data checkin script in AutoIT.  Based on information provided by investigators, script would pull data, log into central database, and enter information into corresponding data fields.

positions.title: Information Technology Intern
positions.description: Wrote a video viewer tracking system to store pertinent information regarding streamed videos.  Streamed video viewer was written in PHP.  When a user views a video, the viewer determines IP address, date information, and view count.  This data is organized and used to ensure that videos are being watched.

positions.title: CG Modeler Intern
positions.description:
Wrote a procedural modeling MEL script to modify the placement of tiles on a floor.
Takes 2 numbers as input for each of the x, y, and z-axes to determine the range of randomly generated values.  These values are used to slightly rotate and translate the tiles to give the floor a natural look.

When a user views a video, the viewer determines IP address, date information, and view count.  This data is organized and used to ensure that videos are being watched.

experience.title: CG Modeler Intern
experience.description:
Wrote a procedural modeling MEL script to modify the placement of tiles on a floor.
Takes 2 numbers as input for each of the x, y, and z-axes to determine the range of randomly generated values.  These values are used to slightly rotate and translate the tiles to give the floor a natural look.
